question.worked_solution:
Recall that the equation of a hyperboloid of one sheet centered at $O$ whose axis of symmetry is the $z$-axis is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=-1.
$$

Thus, a hyperboloid of one sheet centered at $O$ whose axis of symmetry is the $x$**-axis** is given by

$$
-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=-1.
$$

Therefore, our equation is a hyperboloid of one sheet whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis and $a=b=c=1.$
